notes: RETROSPECTIVE, not pre-registered: built after the election with the result known. Every setting (the swing shrinkage, the commune-level noise and the reporting-order error tau, a mixture of the values earlier nights needed) comes from earlier French nights, never from this one; see docs/france.md.

REAL TIMES, NATIONAL TOTALS ONLY: the ministry's results site shows the whole country in one page. The Internet Archive captured 12 distinct versions of it during this night, from 19:25 UTC to 23:19 UTC, each with every candidate's votes and the registered voters already counted (48% to nan%). A version is dated by its first capture, so the count may have been public a few minutes earlier. The first captured version already had a large part of the vote in; the exit-poll estimate at 18:00 UTC is not used.

NO MARKET LINE: Polymarket listed markets on this election, but its price API returns no history for them any more (checked 2026-10-31) and Kalshi had no French market in 2022, so this page shows the model only and no lead over a market can be measured. The Polymarket markets that existed are listed in docs/france.md.

The map is not drawn: the ministry's page gives national totals, not which communes are in. The model assumes communes are counted from the smallest to the largest (small rural communes first, big cities and French citizens abroad last). Every departure from that order is the reporting-order error tau.
Prior: each commune's result in the 2022 first round (the two runoff candidates only); the 2022 registered voters (the electoral roll) set each commune's size.

90% bands use the equal-weight mixture of tau from the earlier nights (0.03, 0, 0.05); the sensitivity `point` uses the single value 0.05. Only two to three earlier nights exist, one of them with two usable frames, so the mixture is thin; the 2017 first round and runoff and the 2022 first round were archived, 2012 was not.
Official final (Ministère de l'Intérieur, results by polling station), share of valid votes: Macron 58.55%, Le Pen 41.45%.
Share and raw (main race) are the first candidate's share of the two compared candidates' votes (round 1) or of all valid votes (runoff); the two other races have no share line except Macron first.

sensitivities.label: one tau (0.05) instead of the mixture of earlier nights' tau
sensitivities.note: The model is run once with the single reporting-order error that the repo's pre-mixture rule picks from the same earlier nights (smallest value whose 90% bands cover 90% of the earlier frames and 75% on each earlier night). The mixture is the headline; this line shows how much one number differs from it.
